'''Olivier De Ridder Abbysin Power''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Olivier De Ridder]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-5444">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5444 Abbysin Power], DeckTech (Olivier "Bel Iblis" De Ridder, 14 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/5444/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/5444/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018183143/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5444/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Olivier De Ridder]]
* '''Published:''' 14 April 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Abbysin Power''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Jabba's Palace|JP-D-tatooinejabbaspalace.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Combat Readiness|Endor-D-combatreadiness.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor TatJP Ridder DS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits Beelo: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' This deck has only lost once against a force d-deck and is very capable of batteling both land and space away. With Gallid you can set up very powerfull drains at Jabba's Palace, and Abyssins are a true recurring nightmare for your opponent

== Original post ==

'''Abbysin Power'''
* '''Author:''' Olivier "Bel Iblis" De Ridder
* '''Published:''' April 14, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 3.5
* '''Description:''' This deck has only lost once against a force d-deck and is very capable of batteling both land and space away. With Gallid you can set up very powerfull drains at Jabba's Palace, and Abyssins are a true recurring nightmare for your opponent

=== Strategy ===

You start Jabba's Palace + JP audience ch. using combat readiness. Then you start pulling those sites AND those aliens. Myo can make your Abyssins power 4 each ) Galid is a very solid drain guy. Jabba is simply cool activate +1 each time you drain with an alien, and makes them forfeit +1 you battel 'em away with abbysins and you revive them. that's not difficult because you have massive activation everything you draw, you can deploy, so you don't need reactor terminals. This deck can battle Operatives without difficulties, and has strong anti hidden base and MWYHL defense. It works try it and be amazed.

Notice  You can throw in None shall pass if you find it necessairy. OOPS  Nalan Cheel should be Chal Beckan
